tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search Boken Japan listings (sights, things to do, places to eat, places to stay, day-to-day) by name or keyword, optionally within a prefecture and/or town and by category. Returns facts with the bokenjapan.com page, source URL, town access, checked booking links (stays) and last_verified.

tools.name: get_town
tools.description: Overview of one Boken Japan town (municipality): names EN/JA, coordinates, access (nearest station, car needed), official links, address and phone of the town office, listing counts by type, section pages, sample listings and stays with checked booking links.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: One listing by id (format <prefecture>/<town>/<section>/<slug>, as returned by search_places or get_town), with all published facts.

tools.name: list_towns
tools.description: Without prefecture: the 47 prefectures with town and listing counts. With prefecture: every town in it with names, page URL and listing counts.
